import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a bar chart to visualize the distribution of sleep duration by gender
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Age', data=df)
ax.set_title('Sleep Duration by Gender and Age')
ax.set_xlabel('Gender')
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax.legend(title='Age')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between physical activity level and sleep quality
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Physical Activity Level', y='Quality of Sleep', data=df)
ax.set_title('Relationship between Physical Activity Level and Sleep Quality')
ax.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Quality')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a histogram to visualize the distribution of heart rate
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(x='Heart Rate', data=df)
ax.set_title('Distribution of Heart Rate')
ax.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (beats per minute)')
ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a box plot to visualize the distribution of daily steps by gender

ax.set_xlabel('Gender')
ax.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
